about: Storm-drainage worked examples transcribed from FHWA HEC-22 Urban Drainage Design, 4th edition, FHWA-HIF-24-006, February 2024 (source W2 in ../sources.md; US federal work, public domain). Values in US customary units as printed (CU: ft, ft3/s, in/h, ac); the SI values printed in parentheses are rounded conversions and are NOT gated. 'derived' = the printed equation recomputed in double precision from the printed inputs (scratch script, node, 2026-10-28). llull works in SI: a case converts the inputs exactly (1 ft = 0.3048 m) and compares in SI against derived x conversion, with the CU constant replaced by its SI form (Ku 0.56 -> 0.376 gutter; 1.486 -> 1.0 Manning; KQ 0.46 -> 0.312 pipe, see TECHNICAL_SPEC 8.3).

cases.example: Example 4.1 Calculation of the runoff coefficient (pp. 25-26), eq. 4.1
cases.tolerance: 1e-6 rel on derived; published to 3 decimals

cases.example: Example 4.3 Rational Method peak flow (p. 31), Q = C i A / Ku with Ku = 1 (CU)

inputs.i_note: i read by the authors from the IDF curve of Figure 4.1 at tc = 88 / 66 min; the case gives i as an input, it does not test the curve read

errata: the solution prints the proposed flow as '31.4 ft3/s (89 m3/s)'; 31.4 ft3/s = 0.889 m3/s
the 'Given' block states Area = 43.36 ac while the computation uses 43.3 ac (as Example 4.1)

cases.example: Example 5.1 Computation of triangular gutter flow (p. 48), eqs. 5.2 / 5.4, Ku = 0.56
Example 5.2 part A Composite gutter flow at T = 8.2 ft (pp. 49-50), eqs. 5.2, 5.6, 5.7, 5.8
cases.note: part B (spread for Q = 4.2 ft3/s, iterative, published T = 11.1 ft) is recorded but not gated: the published iteration stops at a rounded Qs and its T depends on that stop
cases.tolerance: 1e-6 rel on derived; published Q within 1 %

cases.example: Example 6.1 Application of Manning's equation, trapezoidal channel (pp. 66-67), eqs. 6.5, 6.7-6.9, Ku = 1.486
cases.tolerance: 1e-6 rel on derived; published Q is 0.4 % low (A and R rounded before the product)

cases.example: Example 9.1 Pipe size alternative and capacity (pp. 140-141), eq. 9.2 D = [Q n / (KQ So^0.5)]^0.375 with KQ = 0.46, KV = 0.59 (CU)
cases.note: KQ = 0.46 is (1.486 x pi/4 / 4^(2/3)) rounded: an implementation using the exact full-pipe Manning form gives 0.5 % more; the case gates on the exact form (llull computes geometry, not the rounded constant) with 1 % tolerance on the published values, and records the rounded-constant values
cases.tolerance: 1 % vs published; 1e-6 rel vs exact Manning; selected standard size exact (21 in, 24 in)
